reason: 独立银行玩法恢复及虫族重大重做使旧说明失实，立即纠正；同轮合并已完成手机菜单、更新日志、三项Bug和手雷冷却，不逐版本更新。

records.old:
游戏试玩：https://www.zhengxiaohui.cn/games.html
在列表选择「虫潮围城」，主菜单进入「战地模式·据点争夺」；链接不可点击时可复制到浏览器。
本片记录愿望榜双人对战塔防的旧版玩法，包含1对1到4对4、独立银行与队伍转账。本片演示普通规则电脑对战，4对4段落为1个玩家席位加7个电脑。
虫潮对战模式由 Claude 开发，Codex 完成接管核验与本期视频制作。
旧版银行和出兵玩法现已改为据点战，详见下方更新。
玩法建议／愿望单：https://www.zhengxiaohui.cn/game-vote.html

更新（2026-10-11·网站v0.34.0）：战地模式与抗战战役现在是步行第一人称手动瞄准、按住射击；载具和骑马保持第三人称，手机提供轻度辅助瞄准。网站保留本地存档与文件备份恢复，游戏内不再使用网站账号登录或网站账号云档。网站与Toy均已更新，Toy保留平台官方云档，各平台存档独立，不可用时继续本地保存。本片为录制时版本，以当前游戏操作提示为准。

records.old_description:
Play my games: https://www.zhengxiaohui.cn/games.html
Select 虫潮围城 in the list; copy the URL into your browser if it is not clickable.
Collect supplies, upgrade weapons, place turrets, raid the queen, then return to defend the base.
Edited development footage recorded on 2026-10-04. Features, controls and issues shown belong to that earlier build; the current demo may differ.
English narration and captions; Chinese captions are also provided. The game interface is currently in Chinese; follow the current in-game control prompts.
English-language experiment for this gameplay episode; Swarm Siege is the translated title used in this video.

Update (2026-10-10, v0.33.0): The browser game now includes abandoned-town RV exploration and a three-chapter campaign. The old versus mode has been replaced by three-point conquest with fixed classes and equipment, control points and reinforcement tickets; the old leveling, troop purchases and banks no longer apply. Camera response and shop scrolling have been improved, and explosion/hit screen shake has been removed. This video remains a recording of its original version.

Update (2026-10-11, v0.36.1): Bank tower-defense battles are back as an independent mode (银行塔防对战), including bank upgrades, troop purchases and construction; conquest is still available separately. In Zerg mode, destroy three shield outposts, breach the gate, then destroy the core. The mobile title menu now fits its screen, and update history is available from the main and pause menus. Grenades remain unlimited with a 3-second cooldown. Fixed clipping through burrow floors after leaving vehicles, enemies aggroing through outer walls, and blocked rooftop jumps. Website and Toy versions are updated.

archived_baseline.description:
Play my games: https://www.zhengxiaohui.cn/games.html
Choose 虫潮围城 (Swarm Siege) from the list, then 房车生存 (RV survival). The game menus are currently in Chinese. Copy the address into your browser if it is not clickable.
I drive into an abandoned town, upgrade the roof gun, refuel, search for supplies, repair the RV and evacuate with 314 scrap. Next time I will try all six districts.
The RV town gameplay was developed with Codex assistance. Would you upgrade the gun or add armor first? You can suggest game ideas through the voting page linked from the game list.
Chinese narration with selectable Chinese and English subtitles.

Update (2026-10-11, website v0.34.0): Conquest and the three-chapter campaign now use first-person manual aiming and held fire while on foot; vehicles and horses use third-person views. Touch controls include light aim assist. Saves use local storage and file backup/restore; in-game website-account login and account cloud saves have been removed. Website and Toy versions are updated. Toy retains official platform cloud saves independently, with local saves available when cloud support is unavailable. This video preserves the earlier recorded gameplay.
